parameters.query:
INSERT INTO intel.fundamentals (ticker, as_of, market_cap, pe, ps, pb, ev_ebitda, fcf_yield, rev_growth_yoy, rev_growth_q_yoy, eps_growth_yoy, gross_margin, op_margin, net_margin, roe, debt_equity, current_ratio, beta, avg_vol_10d, source, raw, updated_at)
SELECT ticker, as_of, market_cap, pe, ps, pb, ev_ebitda, fcf_yield, rev_growth_yoy, rev_growth_q_yoy, eps_growth_yoy, gross_margin, op_margin, net_margin, roe, debt_equity, current_ratio, beta, avg_vol_10d, 'finnhub', raw, now()
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(ticker text, as_of date, market_cap numeric, pe numeric, ps numeric, pb numeric, ev_ebitda numeric, fcf_yield numeric, rev_growth_yoy numeric, rev_growth_q_yoy numeric, eps_growth_yoy numeric, gross_margin numeric, op_margin numeric, net_margin numeric, roe numeric, debt_equity numeric, current_ratio numeric, beta numeric, avg_vol_10d bigint, raw jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (ticker, as_of) DO UPDATE SET market_cap = EXCLUDED.market_cap, pe = EXCLUDED.pe, ps = EXCLUDED.ps, pb = EXCLUDED.pb, ev_ebitda = EXCLUDED.ev_ebitda, fcf_yield = EXCLUDED.fcf_yield, rev_growth_yoy = EXCLUDED.rev_growth_yoy, rev_growth_q_yoy = EXCLUDED.rev_growth_q_yoy, eps_growth_yoy = EXCLUDED.eps_growth_yoy, gross_margin = EXCLUDED.gross_margin, op_margin = EXCLUDED.op_margin, net_margin = EXCLUDED.net_margin, roe = EXCLUDED.roe, debt_equity = EXCLUDED.debt_equity, current_ratio = EXCLUDED.current_ratio, beta = EXCLUDED.beta, avg_vol_10d = EXCLUDED.avg_vol_10d, source = EXCLUDED.source, raw = EXCLUDED.raw, updated_at = now();
INSERT INTO intel.api_usage (run_id, source, endpoint, ticker, status, http_code)
SELECT $2::uuid, 'finnhub', 'stock/metric', ticker, status, http_code
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS u(ticker text, status text, http_code int);

const f = $('Flatten metrics').first().json;
return [{ json: { source: 'fundamentals', rows: f.count, calls: f.calls, failed: f.failed, failed_tickers: f.failed_tickers, ok: f.calls > 0 && f.failed < f.calls } }];

parameters.content:
## Input

Called with {run_id, as_of, tickers[], benchmarks[]}.

## Fan out + fetch

One item per non-ETF ticker. neverError with the full response: a bad reply becomes a ledger row, not a crash.

## Normalize + store

Unit conversion, then one transaction: upsert on (ticker, as_of) plus one intel.api_usage row per call.

## Return

Counts and failed tickers go back to Daily for the run status.

## Collect-Fundamentals: source + rules

**Finnhub stock/metric?metric=all**, one call per non-ETF ticker, 1.1 s apart, about a minute. About 130 fields; the mapped ones land in intel.fundamentals columns, the whole payload stays in `raw`.
**Units**: Finnhub gives market cap and volume in millions and growth, margins and ROE in percent. Stored as dollars, shares and fractions. fcf_yield = 1 / (EV / FCF).
**Coverage** varies a lot on this watchlist: mature names return everything, pre-profit names have no P/E, EV/EBITDA or FCF multiple, a few return little beyond market cap and balance sheet. Missing is stored as NULL, never zero; the value score reads what exists and records its coverage.
One snapshot per ticker per session (as_of), upserted, so the history of multiples builds up daily.
